spots.name: Castle of Charles V

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Castle of Charles V, also known as the Castello di Lecce, is a historic fortress located in Lecce, Italy. Originally constructed during the Middle Ages, the castle was extensively reinforced in 1539 under the orders of Charles V. The redesign was carried out by the military architect Gian Giacomo dell'Acaya.
